# Light Industrial

> Manufacturing and stock control software for South African workshops, fabricators
> and small manufacturers. Supplier paperwork is photographed instead of retyped:
> the system reads the line items, matches them to the business's own stock codes
> and suppliers, and keeps buying, receiving and stock in one place.

Built and run by Hybrida, Cape Town. Prices are quoted in South African rand,
excluding VAT.

## Who it is for

Manufacturers, engineering workshops, fabricators, refrigeration and cold-chain
firms, and similar businesses with a stores function and a steady flow of
supplier deliveries. The qualifying symptom is that paper documents pile up
faster than they get captured, and a specific person's day is being eaten by it.

## What it does

- Reads supplier quotes, invoices and delivery notes from a PDF, an email or a
  phone photo.
- Matches the lines to the stock items and suppliers the business already has,
  rather than creating duplicates. Anything unfamiliar is proposed for a person
  to approve.
- Handles the units a business actually counts in, and deliveries that arrive
  short or in parts.
- Keeps a record of what was delivered, which the paper delivery note usually
  does not survive to provide.
